Lane F stage A item A12. Two wall-clock-bound tests against the in-process index half. (1) EngineFileLockContentionTest (the converted WindowsTortureTest): on 2026-09-07, scheduler starvation was the working timing hypothesis after both methods exceeded their 180s liveness budget during a concurrent ./gradlew test despite passing in ~10s under :modules:app-engine:test. The 2026-09-08 preserved failure instead proved a distinct product defect: a Windows lock IOException permanently closed the Lucene writer while the in-process Engine remained alive. The test stays quarantined at full assertion strength while whole-process supervised recovery is repaired; machine load is not an established cause of that failure. (2) EngineExtractionSandboxChaosTest (the converted in-process half of the retired ExtractionSandboxChaosTest): it wedges an extraction child for a whole 60s TimeboxedContentExtractor deadline and then exhausts a child heap, so it runs for minutes BY CONSTRUCTION -- not because the machine is loaded. Either way the default inner loop is the wrong tier for it.
